subject: SIG/CAIQ request — BCP walkthrough and RTO/RPO details
messages:
From: Lisa Park <lpark@finserv-example.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Cc: ShieldAudit Team <sig@shieldaudit.com>
Date: 2026-09-01T09:14:00Z
Subject: SIG/CAIQ data request: BCP & RTO/RPO details

Hi Jonas,

Thanks for the quick onboarding call yesterday. As part of our security review we need to finalize SIG and CAIQ artifacts related to Business Continuity and Disaster Recovery. Specifically we need:

- RTO and RPO numbers for customer-facing inference endpoints and control-plane components (matrix preferred)
- A copy of the DR runbook you’d use for a multi-AZ failover (high level steps + escalation contacts)
- Confirmation on backup retention (snapshots, object store retention) and restore SLAs
- Answers to SIG questions #BCP-12 and #BCP-17 about warm standby and failover verification cadence

Can you confirm you can provide these by EOD Friday (2026-09-03)? We’d also like a short runbook walkthrough the week after.

Appreciate it — happy to add ShieldAudit to the call.

Best,
Lisa Park
Director, Security Engineering
FinServ Bank

Attachment: none

From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
To: Lisa Park <lpark@finserv-example.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-09-01T12:03:00Z
Subject: Re: SIG/CAIQ data request: BCP & RTO/RPO details

Hi Lisa — thanks for the clear list. We can take the deliverables you listed. To get the team aligned I’m attaching an initial RTO/RPO matrix covering the key control-plane and inference tiers, and a PDF export of the runbook summary (redacted for customer-facing items).

Proposed next steps:
- I’ll drop the RTO/RPO matrix and runbook snapshot in this thread (see attachments).
- Ops walkthrough — can we target Monday 2026-09-06 at 14:00 ET? 30 mins to go over failover flow and verification/metrics.
- We’ll prepare explicit SIG question responses (BCP-12, BCP-17) and send a short spreadsheet by Friday EOD.

Attachments (stub):
- redwood_rto_rpo_matrix_2026.xlsx (xlsx) — matrix with component-level RTO/RPO, recovery playbook references
- runbook-export-ops.pdf (pdf) — sanitized runbook excerpt for external review

CC’ing Rishi (Head of SRE) and Neha (Compliance) to coordinate the walkthrough and provide the SIG spreadsheet.

Thanks,
Jonas Weber
Head of Product Security (on rotation)
Redwood Inference

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-09-02T08:46:00Z
Subject: Re: SIG/CAIQ data request: BCP & RTO/RPO details

Thanks Jonas — I’ll take point on the ops walkthrough. A few notes from the SRE side that we should have ready before the call:

- Recovery tests: we have quarterly full-region failover rehearsals (last run: 2026-06-11). Post-run metrics and recovery time logs are in the linked drive.
- Warm standby: primary inference fleet is configured with cross-AZ replication + periodic state sync (KV cache priming). We’ll include the warm-standby verification steps in the SIG responses.
- Backups: snapshots retained 90 days by default; critical config snapshots retained 365 days. We’ll include retention policy IDs and S3 lifecycle rules.
- Recovery ownership: include escalation tree (Ops oncall -> SRE manager -> Product security). I’ve attached the internal escalation appendix for reference.

Suggested walkthrough agenda (30 min):
1) High-level failover flow (10 min)
2) Demo of runbook steps and verification checks (10 min)
3) Q&A + next artifacts (10 min)

Marissa, Neha — tagging you for compliance evidence and to sign off the SIG response spreadsheet.

Rishi
Director, SRE
Redwood Inference

Attachments (internal stub): escalation_roles_appendix.pdf

From: Lisa Park <lpark@finserv-example.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Cc: ShieldAudit Team <sig@shieldaudit.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-09-02T14:20:00Z
Subject: Re: SIG/CAIQ data request: BCP & RTO/RPO details

Jonas / Rishi — Monday 2026-09-06 14:00 ET works for FinServ and ShieldAudit. Two quick clarifications to help our reviewer triage:

- Can you confirm the matrix separates RTO/RPO for the inference "request path" (model serving) versus the control plane (model uploads, audit logs)? We need explicit numbers per layer.
- For SIG question BCP-12: please state the frequency of warm-standby verification and the last date a warm failover was executed as a test.
- For BCP-17: provide the shortest observed restore time in your most recent rehearsal (we use this to validate the claimed RTO).

Also, if you can add an acceptance checklist (items we can tick during the walkthrough) that would speed approval.

Can you send the SIG spreadsheet ahead of the call so ShieldAudit has soft time to review?

Thanks,
Lisa

On 2026-09-02 08:46, Rishi Malhotra wrote:
> Thanks Jonas — I’ll take point on the ops walkthrough. A few notes from the SRE side that we should have ready before the call...

From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
To: Lisa Park <lpark@finserv-example.com>, ShieldAudit Team <sig@shieldaudit.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-09-03T17:22:00Z
Subject: Re: SIG/CAIQ data request: BCP & RTO/RPO details

Lisa / ShieldAudit — attaching the SIG response workbook and final artifacts ahead of Monday’s walkthrough. Below are the short answers you requested (we’ve also populated the spreadsheet with references and evidence links):

Quick answers:
- Matrix separation: yes — the attached redwood_rto_rpo_matrix_2026.xlsx breaks out RTO/RPO by component: API ingress, model-serving tier (gpu-pool), KV cache priming, control-plane services (uploads, metadata, audit logs).
- BCP-12 (warm-standby verification): verification run every 30 days for critical regions; last warm failover rehearsal: 2026-06-11 (full recovery logs linked in sheet).
- BCP-17 (shortest observed restore): 00:42:18 (hh:mm:ss) — measured during 2026-06-11 rehearsal for a single-region failover for customer-serving endpoints.

Attached (stubs):
- SIG-responses-v1.2.xlsx (xlsx) — filled SIG answers with links to runbook sections and logs
- redwood_rto_rpo_matrix_2026.xlsx (xlsx) — component-level RTO/RPO and references to audit logs
- runbook-export-ops.pdf (pdf) — sanitized failover playbook excerpt

Walkthrough acceptance checklist (short):
[ ] Confirm component separation in matrix
[ ] Review warm-standby verification sample logs
[ ] Walk through the orchestration steps for DNS / routing cutover
[ ] Validate restore time against recent rehearsal metrics
[ ] Confirm escalation contacts for on-call and post-recovery postmortem

If that looks good I’ll send a calendar invite for 2026-09-06 14:00 ET and we’ll run the 30-minute walkthrough. If you want additional logs pre-seeded for ShieldAudit, let me know and Rishi will attach them.

Thanks,
Jonas Weber
Head of Product Security
Redwood Inference

Attachments: SIG-responses-v1.2.xlsx; redwood_rto_rpo_matrix_2026.xlsx; runbook-export-ops.pdf
